answer.text: Staying invested over long periods to smooth out market ups and downs
Timing exits precisely before every correction

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 42 defines time diversification as staying invested over long periods to balance market ups and downs (time in market). The Trap: Precise timing, zero-equity periods, and hyper-frequent rebalancing do not describe time diversification. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A page 42.
